faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about OssTrack.
faq.a1: Yes. OssTrack is 100% free for academies, instructors and students — no hidden plans, no student limits and no credit card required.
faq.a2: GPS check-in for students, belt and graduation progression, streaks, ranking, attendance tracking, finance and reports — all in one place, in the browser.
faq.q3: Do I need to install an app?
faq.a3: No. OssTrack works right in your phone or computer browser. You can add it to your home screen and use it like an app (PWA).
faq.a4: Students open OssTrack, enable GPS and tap check-in. Attendance is recorded with the current time and is pending confirmation by the professor.
faq.q5: Does it work for any academy size?
faq.a5: Yes. From small classes to large teams, OssTrack tracks attendance, progression and student retention in real time.

gamification.guideStep1Desc: XP (experience points) is how you evolve on OssTrack. Every check-in, completed mission and unlocked achievement gives you XP. The more XP you have, the higher your level!
gamification.guideStep2Desc: The streak counts how many days in a row you train. Keeping an active streak gives you bonuses and shows your dedication. If you miss a day, the streak resets.
gamification.guideStep3Desc: There are 12 levels in total: Beginner → Warrior → Fighter → Blue Belt → Competitor → Athlete → Graduate → Expert → Master → Grandmaster → Legend → Kami. Each level requires more XP than the previous one.
gamification.guideStep4Desc: Every day you get missions like 'Train Today' or 'Early Bird'. Completing them guarantees extra XP. Weekly missions are more challenging but are worth more points.
gamification.guideStep5Desc: Achievements are special milestones: training 30 days, a 7-day streak, being Master of the Month, etc. Every unlocked achievement is worth a 50 XP bonus!

corpo.s1p1: Every Jiu-Jitsu academy knows this phenomenon: the student who shows up excited, trains like a lion for two weeks, and then suddenly disappears. The message on WhatsApp stays unanswered. The kimono gathers dust in the closet.
corpo.s1p2a: It's not a lack of willpower. It's a lack of
corpo.s1p2b: . The student never felt part of something bigger. They came for the Jiu-Jitsu, but they would have stayed for the community — and no community was built.
corpo.s1p3a: Retention studies in martial arts show that a student who builds a connection with the group in the first 30 days is
corpo.s1p3b: to stay active after 6 months. The secret isn't in the monthly fee — it's in daily engagement.
corpo.s1Tip: 💡 Students don't cancel because it's expensive. They cancel because they don't feel part of something.
corpo.s2Intro: Community doesn't happen by accident. It has to be cultivated with intent. Here are the strategies that high-engagement academies use to create belonging:
corpo.s2aBody: The greeting at the door, the welcome on the mat, the post-training chat. It seems simple, but it's what sets an academy apart from a "gym with a kimono on the side". Create ritual moments: every Friday has a 5-minute round of talk after training. The birthday student of the month gets a group congratulations. A student who completes 10 classes gets public recognition.
corpo.s2bBody: If the student shows up, trains and leaves in 5 minutes, they don't build a bond. Encourage them to stay: a shared coffee, a bench in the common area, a WhatsApp group that isn't just for announcements. The bond is formed in the 15 minutes after training, not during the roll.
corpo.s2cBody: A professor who calls the student by name has a deep impact on engagement. On OssTrack, you have the full list of students with belt, degree and attendance — use that data to personalize the interaction. "Hey João, I saw you took 4 classes this week, congratulations!" is worth more than any discount.
corpo.s3Intro: Gamification isn't about turning everything into a game. It's about using game elements to motivate real behavior. In Jiu-Jitsu, that's natural — the belt already is an intrinsic gamification. But you can go further:
corpo.s3aBody: Nothing motivates more than a streak. On OssTrack, the student sees the streak on fire — 3 days, 7 days, 30 days. Losing the streak hurts more than losing a match. Use that to your advantage. Create a "Streak of the Month" board at the academy. The student with the longest streak gets featured.
corpo.s3bBody: Ranking by number of attendances in the month (not by technical performance) encourages frequency without creating intimidation. The student who trained the most in the month gets recognition — it can be a sticker, a t-shirt, or simply the name on the board. On OssTrack, the ranking is automatic.
corpo.s3cBody: Celebrate small victories: the first week without missing, the first finish during free rolling, 30 classes completed. Every achievement becomes a notification in the student's app. They feel seen. On OssTrack, achievements are automatic and the student receives a virtual badge.
corpo.s3Tip: 🥋 OssTrack was built with real gamification: XP, levels 1 to 12, streak with fire, achievements, ranking and Master of the Month. All free.
corpo.s4Intro: The biggest retention factor in a Jiu-Jitsu academy is the professor. Not the structure, not the price, not the location. It's the professor-student relationship.
corpo.s4aBody: When the professor uses OssTrack to congratulate, mark attendance and interact on the wall, the class engagement doubles. A professor who posts on the academy wall — a technique video, an announcement, a word of encouragement — creates a daily return flow for students.
corpo.s4bBody: A "congratulations on your progress" or "great roll today" said individually transforms the student's experience. Use OssTrack's data to know who trained, who's arriving late, who's disappearing — and act before the student gives up.
corpo.s4cBody: The professor who replies on WhatsApp, who gives individual attention, who remembers the student's life outside the mat — that professor shapes students for life. Don't outsource the welcome.
corpo.s5Intro: Having students isn't enough — you have to keep the flame alive between trainings. Here are communication strategies that work:
corpo.s5i1Text: Clear rules, valuable content, training photos, advance notice. No chain messages or irrelevant notes. One message a day, maximum.
corpo.s5i2Text: OssTrack has a built-in wall. Post the week's technique, competition results, congratulations for a student who moved up a belt. The wall generates passive engagement — the student opens the app to see what's new.
corpo.s5i3Text: "Whoever trains 5 days this week gets featured on the wall." "Best check-in streak of the month gets a kimono." Challenges generate movement and conversation.
corpo.s5i4Label: Content that teaches beyond the mat:
corpo.s5i4Text: Short technique videos, stretching tips, explanations of competition rules. A student who consumes academy content outside class hours trains more engaged.
corpo.s6IntroA: High-engagement academies have one thing in common:
corpo.s6i1Text: A ceremony every two months with belt awarding, family presence, photos. It's the most emotional moment on the academy calendar.
corpo.s6i2Text: The student with the most attendances in the month gets featured on the wall, in the app and on the academy's social media. On OssTrack, Master of the Month is automatic.
corpo.s6i3Text: Invite a black belt from outside, run a seminar, a big immersion class on Saturday. It breaks the routine and renews enthusiasm.
corpo.s6i4Text: Barbecue, secret Santa, prize giving. An academy that celebrates together strengthens its bonds for the following year.
corpo.s7Intro: What isn't measured isn't managed. To improve engagement, you need to know where you stand. On OssTrack, all of these metrics are available in real time:

tabela.r1: How many classes the student takes per week
tabela.r3: % of students who quit without notice

corpo.s7Outro: On OssTrack, you see exactly who is disappearing and can act before the cancellation. A "7 days without training" alert fires a notification for the professor — who sends a WhatsApp right away.
corpo.s8Intro: Engagement doesn't hold up on manual effort. You need tools that work for you 24 hours a day. OssTrack was built to be the engagement hub of your academy:
corpo.s8i1Text: The student checks in, the app records it, the streak grows, the fire lights up. Zero effort from the professor.
corpo.s8i2Text: The professor posts, the student comments, likes appear. The community interacts even outside the mat.
corpo.s8i3Text: Training reminder, unlocked achievement, Master of the Month, level up. The student gets positive encouragement every day.
corpo.s8i4Text: Students compete for attendance, not for performance. Everyone can win.
corpo.s8i5Text: No monthly fee, no student limit, no premium plan. Real engagement shouldn't have an entry barrier.

pagAjuda.faq1r: OssTrack is a management and evolution platform for Jiu-Jitsu academies. We help academies, professors and students track attendance, belt progression, streaks, achievements and much more — all with a focus on motivation and discipline.
pagAjuda.faq2r: Academies and professors pay nothing — it's free. All features are 100% free for students, including evolution charts, special achievements and Master of the Month.
pagAjuda.faq3r: The student opens the app at training time and taps 'Check In'. The platform uses the phone's geolocation to confirm the student is at the academy. The professor can also record attendance manually.
pagAjuda.faq4q: Do I need a separate app?
pagAjuda.faq4r: No. OssTrack works straight from your phone browser — there's nothing to install. You can add the page to your phone's home screen for quick access like an app.
pagAjuda.faq5r: The academy owner configures the graduation rules (classes per degree, criteria for each belt). The system automatically calculates each student's progress and suggests when they're ready to move up a degree or belt.
pagAjuda.faq6r: Yes. All data is transmitted with HTTPS/TLS encryption and stored in an encrypted database at rest. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. We don't store credit card numbers — payments are processed directly by Stripe (PCI DSS Level 1 certified).
pagAjuda.faq7q: Can I use OssTrack in multiple academies?
pagAjuda.faq7r: Professors can be linked to multiple academies. Students belong to a single academy at a time. Owners can manage one or more academies with the same account.
pagAjuda.faq8r: Use the 'Contact Us' form below, email passador@osstrack.com or send a message on WhatsApp: (11) 94222-1028.

pagLgpd.subtitulo: How we protect your data and respect your privacy on OssTrack, in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD).
pagLgpd.s1b: We only collect the essential data for the platform to work: name, email, phone, profile picture, Jiu-Jitsu belt and degree, date of birth, attendance records (with geolocation at the moment of check-in), liability waiver (full name, CPF, IP address and device data) if your academy requires it, and usage information in statistical format. If your academy enables billing, payment data is processed exclusively by Stripe, without storing card numbers on our servers.
pagLgpd.s2b: Your data is used to: record and display your attendance history and belt evolution, calculate streaks and achievements, generate academy rankings, manage the platform, send relevant notifications via WhatsApp or email, and continually improve the platform experience.
pagLgpd.s3b: We process your data under the LGPD (Law 13.709/2018): (a) performance of the contract, for the platform to work and for managing your academy's attendance, classes, billing and rankings; (b) consent, for sending marketing notifications and for the liability waiver; and (c) legitimate interest, for security improvements and fraud prevention. Data from minors under 18 depends on the specific consent of the legal guardian (Art. 14).
pagLgpd.s4b: We don't sell your data to third parties. We share it only with services essential to the operation: Neon PostgreSQL (storage), Vercel (hosting and analytics) and, when billing is enabled, Stripe (payment processing). These services may be located outside Brazil; international transfers take place based on standard contractual clauses and the guarantees required by the LGPD (Art. 33). Your attendance and progress data are visible to your academy's professors and owner, within the limits of the platform.
pagLgpd.s5b: You have the right to: access all data we store about you, request correction of incomplete or outdated data, request anonymization or deletion of your data (subject to legal retention), revoke consent at any time, object to certain processing operations, request portability and information about sharing. You can also file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD). To exercise any right, contact us at passador@osstrack.com.
pagLgpd.s6b: For the registration of minors under 18, we require the consent of the legal guardian, who must provide their name and CPF at the time of registration. The guardian may, at any time, request access, rectification, portability or deletion of the minor's data by emailing passador@osstrack.com. Children's and teenagers' data is handled with maximum protection priority and only to the strict extent necessary for the platform to work.
pagLgpd.s7b: All communication with the platform is encrypted via HTTPS/TLS. Data stored in the PostgreSQL database (Neon) is encrypted at rest, and sensitive data such as CPF is individually encrypted. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Check-in geolocation is used only at the moment of registration to validate attendance and is not tracked continuously. When billing is enabled, we don't store credit card numbers — payment is processed directly by Stripe, PCI DSS Level 1 certified. Role-based access controls (RBAC) ensure each user only sees what they need. We take automatic daily database backups.
pagLgpd.s8b: We use essential cookies for authentication and for the platform to work (NextAuth session). To measure performance and improve the experience, we use Vercel Web Analytics, which collects aggregated and anonymous usage statistics (such as number of visits and most viewed pages), without advertising cookies or cross-site tracking. You can control cookies in your browser settings, but disabling essential cookies may affect how the platform works.
pagLgpd.s9b: We keep your data while your account is active. After a request to delete the account, personal data is anonymized or deleted immediately, except when retention is required by law. Before turning 18, minors' data is kept only with the guardian's consent and is deleted as soon as processing is no longer necessary.
pagLgpd.s10b: For questions about privacy and data protection, including to exercise your rights as a data subject, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at passador@osstrack.com or through the contact form on the Help page.
